name: Acycloid and Planar Rank-Three Profile of Antipodal Partial Cubes
statement: A finite connected graph is an antipodal partial cube exactly when it is the tope graph of a simple acycloid. It is planar and antipodal exactly when it is the tope graph of an oriented matroid of rank at most three. A graph is both median and antipodal exactly when it is a hypercube.
